company_name: Health and Happiness (H&H) International Holdings Limited

inputs.base_revenue_note: LTM to 30 June 2026 = FY2025 14,353.6 + H1 FY2026 8,695.9 - H1 FY2025 7,019.2. FY0 is the trailing twelve months to the balance-sheet date so that the net debt anchor (30 Jun 2026) and the flows that follow it do not overlap; a FY2025 base against a June-2026 balance sheet would count H1 2026's RMB1.66bn of FCF twice.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: 641,778,731 shares outstanding (645,561,354 issued less 3.78m held in trust for the share award scheme; H1 FY2026 interim diluted-EPS table, line 2675) plus 4.2m treasury-method shares for the 12,570,000 options granted 23 Dec 2025 at HKD13.54 strike (in the money at HKD20.28). The 1,634,169 options under the 2020 scheme strike at HKD31.02-31.88 and are excluded as out of the money. Held FLAT because future SBC is expensed in the flows (charge once).
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 June 2026 interim balance sheet (RMB'000, interim lines 1898-1933): bank loans and other borrowings 1,722,099 current + 3,760,989 non-current (includes RMB413.6m guaranteed bonds) and senior notes 80,868 + 2,017,639 = carrying borrowings 7,581.6m; plus the net cross-currency-swap liability hedging the USD debt (derivative liabilities 44,365 + 309,316 less derivative asset 17,509 = 336.2m), because the swaps lock the RMB cost of the USD principal and the spot-translated carrying value alone understates the claim. Cash = cash and equivalents 1,856.3 + time deposits 120.2 = 1,976.5 (the company's own definition). Company-defined net debt at constant drawdown FX is 5,813.7; carrying-only net debt is 5,605.1; the difference to the figure used is <HKD0.6/share. Lease liabilities (140.1m) are EXCLUDED from net debt because lease cash is charged inside the flows (treatment B). The RMB488m ATO deposit sits in non-current Deposits, not cash, and is handled in the equity bridge.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: LTM Jun-2026 operating cash flow 2,233.9 (FY2025 1,536.8 + H1 2026 1,695.1 - H1 2025 998.0; interest paid sits in financing under the company's HKFRS presentation, so OCF is pre-interest / unlevered) less capex 91.8 (PPE + intangibles: FY2025 94.4 + H1 2026 38.4 - H1 2025 41.0). Flattered by ~RMB297m of H1 2026 tax accrued but not yet paid (tax payable 151.9 -> 448.8); the forward build taxes EBIT in full, so the one-off timing benefit is not carried forward.
inputs.sbc_source: Equity-settled share option / share award expense in the consolidated cash flow statements: FY2025 0.777 + 0.342 (Annual FY2025 lines 4365-4366, RMB'000), H1 FY2026 16.233 (interim line 2056), H1 FY2025 0.344 (interim line 2057). No cash taxes on equity awards are disclosed (none paid; options are gross-settled). LTM = 1.119 + 16.233 - 0.344 = 17.0m. The Dec-2025 grant of 13.07m options lifts the run-rate to ~RMB32m/yr (0.2% of revenue), which is what the forward path charges.
inputs.interest_income_note: Bank interest income LTM = FY2025 11.6 + H1 2026 7.5 - H1 2025 6.3 = 12.8m. Stripped because the cash pile it is earned on (RMB1,976.5m) is netted against debt in the bridge; the amount is immaterial either way.
inputs.buyback_note: No share repurchases in any year FY2018-H1 FY2026 (financing activities carry none). The flat count is a modelling convention funded by expensing SBC, not by actual repurchases; the share award trust already holds 3.78m shares.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. CNY->HKD 1.1722 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-09T08:08Z, applied to every per-share value (model currency -> quote currency). No dual listing exists; parity check against the company's own declared interim dividend: HKD0.82/share described as ~50% of H1 FY2026 adjusted net profit RMB919.2m -> 0.5 x 919.2 / 641.78 = RMB0.716/share -> implied CNYHKD 1.145, within 2.4% of spot (the rate at the August declaration), confirming direction and magnitude. FY2025 final dividend RMB90.8m proposed vs RMB89.2m payable at 30 Jun 2026 shows the same HKD-declared/RMB-booked revaluation in the right direction.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-09T08:08:06Z (HKEX regular close, Friday; the stock went ex the HKD0.82 interim dividend on 16 Sep 2026 so the price already excludes it)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in the flows' currency (CNY). Risk-free: 10-year China government bond ~2.0%. Equity risk premium 7.0% for a Hong Kong-listed, 71%-China-revenue mid cap (mature-market 5% plus ~2pp China country premium), beta 1.15 for a leveraged branded-consumer name -> cost of equity ~10.1%. Pre-tax cost of debt 5.65% (company's implied annual interest margin incl. hedges, H1 FY2026) -> ~4.1% after 28% tax; the market-implied cost on the USD 9.125% 2028 notes less the ~2.5pp USD-CNY rate differential gives a similar RMB figure. Weights at market: equity HKD20.28 x 646m = HKD13.1bn = RMB11.2bn; net debt RMB5.9bn -> 65/35 -> WACC 8.0%. Rounded UP to 9.0% in the first build because the capital structure is a sub-investment-grade issuer whose after-tax debt cost does not capture refinancing dependence on Asian high-yield markets. SANITY ITERATION 2 (2026-10-12): raised to 10.0% after the mid-cycle FCF normalisation alone left the implied multiples outside the sanity bounds. The extra 1pp is justified on its own terms: the market cost of the 9.125% USD 2028 notes (~9% USD, ~6.5% RMB-equivalent pre-tax, ~4.7% after tax) rather than the hedged book cost, a relevered beta nearer 1.3 for a 65/35 structure with sub-IG debt (cost of equity ~11%), and the HKD-listed China-consumer small/mid-cap illiquidity premium; 0.65 x 11.1 + 0.35 x 4.7 = 8.9% rounded up to 10.0%. This remains the only risk charge in the discount rate. Operating, China-demand, ATO and leverage risks are charged ONCE, in the scenario paths and the 30% bear weight, not by a per-scenario WACC (same 10.0% in all three).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease cash (principal in financing + interest in operating) is deducted inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path (LTM 48.5 principal + 9.9 interest = 58.3m = 0.36% of revenue; FY2025 lines 4413 and 7253, interim lines 2108 and 2473). Lease liabilities (27.7 + 112.4 = 140.1m) are therefore EXCLUDED from net debt. da_pct_path is depreciation ex right-of-use assets (ROU depreciation ~RMB46m/yr excluded) so the lease is not charged twice. Acquired-intangible amortisation (~RMB200m/yr, mostly Swisse/Zesty Paws/Biostime intangibles with a matching RMB735m deferred tax liability) is also excluded from da_pct: it is non-cash, is not replaced by capex, and the DTL shows it is not a cash-tax shield, so da_pct ~0.6% is PPE depreciation + own software/intangible amortisation only, roughly matching the 0.65-0.7% capex path.
inputs.nci_treatment: None required: no non-controlling interests on the balance sheet (total equity 6,513.8m = net assets; interim lines 1937-1942). Dividends to NCI were last paid in FY2018 (RMB7.1m). Flows are 100% attributable.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company: branded adult/infant/pet nutrition, Swisse/Biostime/Zesty Paws/Solid Gold), routed via .claude/skills/dcf-methods/SKILL.md row 2 (non-US operating company) with owner-fcf-adaptations.md applied for (a) CNY flows vs HKD quote with a CNY-built WACC, (b) lease treatment B, (c) no NCI, (d) excluded-income/matching-asset: associates and other non-current financial assets added to the bridge at book because adjusted EBITDA strips their P&L, (f) risk charged once. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry, no prior DCF). EBITDA base is the company's adjusted EBITDA (LTM Jun-2026 2,841.7m = 17.7% margin; H1 FY2026 21.8%, FY2025 14.3%), which adds back FX/derivative fair-value swings, impairments and 'one-time' restructuring; because such one-offs recur most years (FY2024 RMB260m, FY2025 RMB50m) the base margin path is held ~0.5pp below the LTM level and well below H1 FY2026, consistent with management's flagged H2 2026 marketing step-up. Horizon 10 years (FY1 = twelve months to Jun-2027), discounted end-of-year from the valuation date; FY1 ends ~8.5 months out so the one-full-period convention is slightly conservative. Cash tax is applied to unlevered EBIT at 28% -> 27% (statutory blend China 25% / Australia 30% / US 21% plus Chinese dividend withholding and unrelieved European losses; the interest tax shield is in the after-tax cost of debt in WACC, not in the flows). Price is a regular Friday close, not after-hours. SANITY NORMALISATION (2026-10-12): the first build tripped sanity_check.py (implied P/E 171.8x vs 2x the 10yr average 30.1x; diagnosis peak_fcf, LTM owner FCF 1.51x the historical median). Iteration 1: base rebuilt on mid-cycle owner FCF (inputs.mid_cycle_fcf) and an explicit EV/EBITDA exit-multiple cap per scenario from the stock's own 10-year range (top-level exit_multiple_cap); weighted IV HKD45.99 -> 40.08, implied P/E still >2x average. Iteration 2: WACC raised 9.0% -> 10.0% in all scenarios (see wacc_rationale). Note the P/E denominator is FY2025 reported net income (RMB196m after RMB560m+ of interest, FX/derivative losses and impairments); the market price itself is ~57x that figure, so the P/E rule cannot be cleared by any IV above ~HKD16 and should be read alongside P/B, EV/EBITDA and P/S.
inputs.ato_dispute_note: Biostime Healthy Australia (BHA) amended assessments (interim lines 996-1046): primary tax AUD208.1m (reduced from 234.5 at the 3 Jul 2026 objection decision), interest AUD55.2m to Apr-2025 and accruing at the ATO general interest charge, penalty AUD104.0m (reduced from 117.3). AUD104m deposit paid 15 Jul 2025 (RMB488m at AUDCNY ~4.69, carried in non-current Deposits 509.6m). Federal Court appeal filed 10 Jul 2026, ART review of penalties/interest 16 Jul 2026; no hearing date. Directors consider an outflow not probable. Modelled as a single expected-value bridge item because the outcome is largely independent of operating performance: 30% BHA wins (+RMB488m deposit refund), 35% settles at roughly the deposit (0), 35% full loss (further ~AUD320m incl. interest accrued to a 2028 judgment ~ -RMB1,500m) -> EV = 0.30 x 488 + 0.35 x 0 + 0.35 x (-1,500) = -379 -> -380m. A full loss is ~RMB1,120m (HKD2.0/share) worse than the bridge carries; the bear narrative states it.

mid_cycle_fcf.method: sanity_check.py (2026-10-11) tripped on peak_fcf: LTM owner FCF 2,112.3 is 1.51x the FY2018-FY2025 owner-FCF median 1,399.6. Per the research-stock skill Step 8c.5 the base case is rebuilt on mid-cycle FCF = midpoint(historical median, latest) = 1,756.0 (all SBC-adjusted; the SBC/interest-income adjustments from the first build are retained). Bull uses latest x 0.85 = 1,795.5; bear uses median x 0.75 = 1,049.7.
mid_cycle_fcf.implementation: The engine builds FCF from components, so the normalisation is applied through ebitda_margin_path: base year-1 adjusted EBITDA margin cut from 17.5% to 15.75% (owner-FCF margin ~10.1%), which lands year-1 owner FCF at ~RMB1.79bn = the mid-cycle figure carried onto the year-1 revenue base; long-run margin held at 16.5% (the FY2018-LTM median adjusted EBITDA margin, not the 18% previously assumed). Bull year-1 margin 17.0% (-> ~RMB2.03bn = 1,795 grown at the bull growth rate) rising to 18.5% (the LTM level, no longer the FY2018-2020 20%). Bear margin 12.5% -> 11.0% (the FY2023 cash-conversion trough held), giving owner FCF of ~RMB1.1-1.3bn, in line with median x 0.75. last_fcf stays at the LTM identity 2,112.3 so the diagnosis remains auditable; fcf_base_year is the forward anchor.
mid_cycle_fcf.why_latest_is_peak: LTM FCF carries ~RMB297m of H1 FY2026 tax accrued but unpaid (tax payable 151.9 -> 448.8) and sits on an H1 that grew 23.9% with a 21.8% adjusted EBITDA margin that management itself said was flattered by marketing phasing. Ex the tax timing the LTM figure is ~1,815, so the 1,756 mid-cycle base is a ~3% haircut to underlying LTM, and ~25% above the FY2018-FY2025 median.

inputs.last_fcf_note: LTM Jun-2026 owner FCF identity (reported_fcf - sbc - interest_income). It is the diagnosed peak; the forward flows are anchored on inputs.fcf_base_year (mid-cycle), see inputs.mid_cycle_fcf.

historical_growth.owner_fcf_series_note: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income, FY2018..FY2025: 1,519 / 1,229 / 1,358 / 1,729 / 1,401 / 987 / 1,241 / 1,430 (RMB m). 3-yr CAGR FY2022->FY2025 13.0% is off a 2022 trough; 5-yr FY2020->FY2025 0.7%; 7-yr FY2018->FY2025 -0.9%. Reported-FCF CAGRs are within 0.2pp of these because SBC is negligible (0.1% of revenue).
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_5yr_cagr (FY2020->FY2025, 11,194.7 -> 14,353.6); equity CAGR is negative because of RMB2.8bn of dividends paid over the period against volatile reported earnings and is not a growth signal for a branded consumer business; EPS CAGR is distorted by the FY2024 loss year (impairments, FX) and 13.5% refinancing costs.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (-0.7%) and EPS CAGR (-29%) diverge by >30% from revenue CAGR (+5.1%): the divergence is explained by dividends exceeding retained profit, FY2024 goodwill/intangible impairments (RMB124m) and FY2025 impairment (RMB106.5m), and finance costs that peaked at RMB920m in FY2024. Base-case year-1 growth (10%) is above the 5-year CAGR because it follows observed H1 FY2026 growth of 23.9% and FY2025 of 10.0%; the path decelerates to 2.5% by year 9.

base.growth_rationale: Year 1 (LTM to Jun-2027) +10%: H2 2026 vs H2 2025 (RMB7,334m) ~+13% on management's 'continued growth' plus the H2 marketing push, and H1 2027 ~+7% against the very strong +23.9% H1 2026 comp. Thereafter decelerates toward 2.5% as super-premium IMF share gains (17.1% -> 20.6%) run into the shrinking Chinese birth cohort and Swisse/Douyin growth normalises; PNC and expansion markets keep the blended rate above China nominal GDP for ~5 years.
base.margin_rationale: MID-CYCLE NORMALISED (sanity fix 2026-10-12; previously 17.5% -> 18.0%). Year-1 adjusted EBITDA margin 15.75% is set so that year-1 owner FCF (~RMB1.79bn, 10.1% of revenue) equals the mid-cycle owner FCF of RMB1,756m (midpoint of the FY2018-FY2025 median 1,399.6 and the LTM 2,112.3) carried onto the year-1 revenue base: all of year-1 revenue growth is absorbed by margin normalisation. It sits between FY2025 (14.3%) and the LTM (17.7%), and well below H1 FY2026 (21.8%, flattered by marketing phasing). Rises to 16.5% by year 4 and holds: 16.5% is the median adjusted EBITDA margin across FY2018-LTM (20% in 2018-20, 13-15% in 2021-25) and gives a terminal owner-FCF margin of ~11.1%, which matches the historical median cash FCF margin (~11%). The old 18% long-run level is now reserved for the bull case. Recurring 'one-time' restructuring/consulting items (RMB50m FY2025, RMB260m FY2024) are covered by the normalisation rather than a separate 0.3pp haircut.
base.tax_rationale: 28% on unlevered EBIT in years 1-3 (China 25% / Australia 30% / US 21% statutory blend plus Chinese dividend withholding on repatriation and unrelieved European/US losses), easing to 27% as the loss-making pet/Europe units turn. The company's pro-forma ETR on PBT (36-39%) is higher because the denominator is after RMB550m+ of interest; the interest shield belongs in WACC, not here.
base.wc_rationale: Receivables (RMB1,025m) + inventory (RMB1,982m) exceed trade payables (RMB1,069m) but are roughly covered once other payables/accruals (RMB2,508m) are included; H1 FY2026 working capital consumed RMB17.9m on RMB1,677m of incremental revenue (~1%). -3% of the revenue change is a modest allowance for growth consuming cash (PNC strategic inventory build, overseas credit sales).
base.terminal_rationale: At the 10.0% WACC Gordon growth at 2.5% gives 13.7x year-10 owner FCF (~9.2x terminal adjusted EBITDA at the normalised 16.5% margin), which binds below the retained 15x owner-FCF cap and below the 12.13x EV/EBITDA exit_multiple_cap (10yr average) added by the sanity fix; see top-level exit_multiple_cap. Well below the 16-19x EV/EBITDA the stock carried in 2018-2020.
base.exit_multiple_cap_note: EV/EBITDA cap 12.13x (10yr average) = ~18.1x owner FCF at the terminal conversion; non-binding. min(Gordon 13.7x at 10%/2.5%, 18.1x, retained 15x) = Gordon 13.7x (~9.2x EBITDA).

bull.rationale: MID-CYCLE NORMALISED (sanity fix 2026-10-12): year-1 margin 17.0% puts year-1 owner FCF at ~RMB2.03bn = latest LTM owner FCF x 0.85 (1,795) grown at the bull year-1 rate; long-run margin 18.5% is the LTM level (previously 20%, the FY2018-2020 peak, which is no longer assumed to return). H1 FY2026 momentum carries: Swisse Plus/Little Swisse extensions and Douyin/Sam's Club channel gains keep ANC growing double digits, Biostime super-premium share keeps climbing past 20%, Zesty Paws scales in North America and China after the 2026 localisation, and the thirteen expansion markets replicate Singapore/Hong Kong. Same 10.0% WACC (risk charged once); terminal growth 3.0%; 15x owner-FCF cap retained but Gordon (14.7x, ~10.1x EBITDA) binds, below the 19.19x EV/EBITDA historical ceiling.
bull.exit_multiple_cap_note: EV/EBITDA cap 19.19x (10yr max, FY2018) = ~27.9x owner FCF; non-binding. min(Gordon 14.7x at 10%/3.0%, 27.9x, retained 15x) = Gordon 14.7x (~10.1x EBITDA).

bear.rationale: MID-CYCLE NORMALISED (sanity fix 2026-10-12; previously 15.5% -> 13.0%): margin 12.5% in year 1 falling to 11.0% from year 3, which is the FY2023 cash-conversion trough (owner FCF margin ~7%) held for the decade; owner FCF runs ~RMB1.3bn in year 1 and ~RMB1.1bn thereafter, in line with the prescribed bear anchor of historical median x 0.75 (1,050). H1 FY2026 proves to be a restocking/low-base spike: Chinese consumer confidence weakens, CBEC/Douyin competitive intensity raises acquisition costs for Swisse, the birth-cohort decline overwhelms Biostime's share gains from 2027, PNC China localisation drags longer and Europe/Solid Gold need further write-downs. Revenue flat-to-down for three years then 2% growth. Unrelieved overseas losses hold the cash tax rate at 30%. Terminal cap 12x owner FCF retained but Gordon at 10%/1.5% (11.9x, ~7.3x EBITDA) binds, under the 7.62x 10yr-minimum EV/EBITDA cap. Same 10.0% WACC. Not in these flows: a full ATO loss would take a further ~RMB1,120m (HKD2.0/share) beyond the probability-weighted bridge item. On this path net leverage re-widens toward ~4-5x and refinancing of the 2028 notes becomes the binding constraint.
bear.exit_multiple_cap_note: EV/EBITDA cap 7.62x (10yr min, FY2023) = ~12.4x owner FCF at the bear terminal conversion (~0.61). min(Gordon 11.9x at 10%/1.5%, 12.4x, retained 12x) = Gordon 11.9x (~7.3x EBITDA).

scenario_narratives.base: H&H is a branded consumer-health company whose cash flows have been obscured for four years by refinancing costs, FX/derivative swings and acquisition write-downs rather than by weak operations: adjusted EBITDA never fell below RMB1.9bn even in the FY2024 loss year. The base case assumes the FY2025-26 recovery is real but that H1 FY2026's 21.8% margin is not the run-rate: revenue grows 10% in the twelve months to Jun-2027 (H2 2026 marketing step-up, tough H1 2027 comp) then decelerates to 2.5% as Biostime's super-premium share gains (17.1% -> 20.6%) are offset by China's shrinking birth cohort and Swisse's Douyin growth normalises; adjusted EBITDA margin is normalised to mid-cycle: 15.75% in year 1 (so that year-1 owner FCF of ~RMB1.79bn equals the mid-cycle figure of RMB1,756m, the midpoint of the FY2018-25 median and the LTM) rising to 16.5%, the FY2018-LTM median margin, which also absorbs the 'one-time' items that recur most years. Cash tax 28% -> 27% on unlevered EBIT, lease cash charged in the flows, acquired-intangible amortisation given no tax shield. Deleveraging (3.99x -> 2.05x) accrues to equity through the net-debt bridge, not through the flows. The ATO dispute is carried at a probability-weighted -RMB380m and the two declared dividends paid after the balance-sheet date are deducted. WACC 10.0% after sanity iteration 2 (9.0% in the first build).
scenario_narratives.bull: The axes that have to go right together: (1) Swisse keeps compounding in China through sub-brand extensions and Douyin/new-retail penetration, (2) Biostime's super-premium share climbs past 20% fast enough to outrun a falling birth cohort, (3) Zesty Paws/Solid Gold scale profitably in North America and China once localisation completes, and (4) expansion markets replicate the Singapore/Hong Kong playbook. Operating leverage and supplement mix lift the adjusted EBITDA margin from 17.0% in year 1 (owner FCF ~RMB2.03bn, the LTM x 0.85 anchor grown one year) to 18.5%, the LTM level, no longer the 20% of FY2018-2020; growth runs 14% / 10% / 8% then fades to 3%. Terminal growth 3.0%, same 15x cap and 10.0% WACC (Gordon at 14.7x binds).
scenario_narratives.bear: H1 FY2026 is read as a low-base restocking spike rather than a step-change. Chinese consumer spending softens, cross-border e-commerce and Douyin competition raise Swisse's acquisition costs, the IMF market shrinks faster than Biostime gains share, PNC China localisation drags beyond 2026 and Europe/Solid Gold take further write-downs. Revenue +4% then -2% / -1% before resuming 2% growth; margin falls from 12.5% to 11% (the FY2023 trough), holding owner FCF at ~RMB1.1-1.3bn, roughly the historical median x 0.75; cash tax 30% with unrelieved overseas losses; terminal cap 12x at 1.5% growth. The balance sheet survives this path (net leverage would re-widen toward ~4-5x at RMB1.1-1.3bn of owner FCF against RMB5.9bn net debt, making the 2028 notes refinancing the binding constraint) but equity value compresses. A full ATO loss (~RMB1.5bn incl. accruing interest) would subtract a further ~HKD2.0/share beyond what the weighted bridge item already deducts.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: sub-investment-grade leverage (RMB7.9bn gross debt, 9.125% USD notes, serial refinancings) means an operating stumble propagates to equity quickly; the ATO assessment is a live Federal Court matter with no hearing date; 71% of revenue depends on Chinese consumer demand and a structurally shrinking IMF market; and adjusted earnings exclude items that recur. Bull cut to 20% because it needs four independent things (Swisse China, Biostime share > birth decline, PNC scaling, expansion markets) to go right simultaneously and a margin the group has not earned since 2020. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street values differ by <2% because SBC is ~0.1-0.2% of revenue (near-SBC-zero market); the band is ~HKD0.9 wide and the price sits far outside it, so band_position is not meaningful and is reported as null rather than a degenerate large negative number.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the unlevered owner cash flow of the three nutrition brands in RMB at a CNY-built WACC, charge SBC, lease cash and full cash tax in the flows, and let deleveraging show up only through the 30 June 2026 net-debt bridge. Keep the margin path below the H1 FY2026 spike and haircut for recurring 'one-offs'; charge the ATO dispute once, as an expected-value bridge item, and carry operating/leverage risk in the scenario paths and a 30% bear weight rather than in a scenario-specific WACC. Convert per-share RMB values to HKD at the dated spot rate. SANITY NORMALISATION: the first build's base case extrapolated the LTM owner FCF of RMB2.11bn, 1.5x the FY2018-25 median, and sanity_check.py tripped on implied P/E. The base is therefore rebuilt on mid-cycle owner FCF (RMB1,756m, the midpoint of the historical median and the LTM, via a 15.75% -> 16.5% adjusted EBITDA margin path instead of 17.5% -> 18%), bull on LTM x 0.85 and bear on median x 0.75, and every scenario carries an EV/EBITDA exit-multiple cap from the stock's own 10-year range (7.62x / 12.13x / 19.19x), under which the retained 12x / 15x / 15x owner-FCF terminal caps (~7.4x / 10.1x / 10.3x EBITDA) are the binding constraint. Iteration 2 of the sanity fix raised the WACC from 9.0% to 10.0% in all scenarios (market cost of the 9.125% notes, relevered beta, HK small/mid-cap premium), at which point Gordon growth binds below every cap (terminal ~9.2x / 10.1x / 7.3x EBITDA).
key_risks_to_valuation: ATO transfer-pricing dispute: a full loss (~AUD320m further, incl. accruing interest) is ~HKD2.0/share worse than the probability-weighted bridge; a win adds ~HKD0.9/share (deposit refund).
Leverage and refinancing: RMB7.9bn gross debt incl. swaps against ~RMB2.8bn adjusted EBITDA; a credit-market shock or covenant breach is a path to dilution not modelled in the flat share count.

China demand and channel concentration: 71% of revenue from the Chinese mainland, 82% of China ANC via cross-border e-commerce; platform fee/algorithm changes or weaker consumer confidence hit Swisse directly.
IMF structural decline: Biostime's share gains (20.6% super-premium) run against a birth cohort near multi-decade lows; the base case assumes share gains only partly offset volume decline.

Margin sustainability: H1 FY2026's 21.8% adjusted EBITDA margin included marketing phasing; the model assumes a mid-cycle 15.75-16.5%, and every 1pp of long-run margin is ~HKD3.5-4/share of base value.

Adjusted-earnings quality: 'one-time' restructuring, consulting and impairment items recur most years; the mid-cycle margin normalisation (rather than a separate haircut) is the allowance, and reported FY2025 net income was only RMB196m against RMB2.05bn of adjusted EBITDA.
FX: RMB values are converted at a dated CNY/HKD rate; a 5% RMB move shifts every HKD per-share figure by 5%.

sanity_normalization.trigger: sanity_check.py 2026-10-11: implied P/E 171.8x vs 2x the 10yr average 30.1x; diagnosis peak_fcf (LTM owner FCF 2,112.3 = 1.51x historical median 1,399.6).
sanity_normalization.fix: Iteration 1: mid-cycle FCF base (inputs.mid_cycle_fcf) and EV/EBITDA exit-multiple cap per scenario (exit_multiple_cap), per research-stock skill Step 8c.5 (weighted IV HKD45.99 -> 40.08). Iteration 2: WACC 9.0% -> 10.0% in all scenarios (inputs.wacc_rationale).
sanity_normalization.caveat: The P/E rule divides by FY2025 reported net income (RMB196m after RMB560m+ of interest, FX/derivative losses and impairments). The market price is itself ~57x that figure; clearing 2x the 10yr average (~60x) would need an IV at or below ~HKD16, so the P/E rule is a trough-earnings artefact here and P/B, EV/EBITDA and P/S are the meaningful multiples checks. The valuation should still be read as sensitive to the margin path: every 1pp of long-run adjusted EBITDA margin is ~HKD3.5-4/share of base value.
sanity_normalization.dashboard_banner: Base case normalised to mid-cycle owner FCF (RMB1.76bn vs RMB2.11bn LTM) and WACC raised to 10% after a sanity-check trip on peak-earnings extrapolation; terminal values at ~9-10x adjusted EBITDA (bear ~7.3x), inside the stock's own 10-year EV/EBITDA range. Implied P/E remains high because FY2025 earnings were a trough (interest, FX losses, impairments).

exit_multiple_cap.basis: EV / adjusted EBITDA, from sanity_check.py's 10-year historical range ex outliers (FY2018-FY2025: min 7.62x FY2023, average 12.13x, max 19.19x FY2018).
exit_multiple_cap.rule: terminal value = min(Gordon-growth TV, exit_multiple_cap x terminal-year EBITDA, prior owner-FCF-multiple judgment).
exit_multiple_cap.implementation: The engine's terminal_cap_multiple is expressed as a multiple of year-10 owner FCF. At the normalised terminal margins the owner-FCF / adjusted-EBITDA conversion is ~0.67 (base, 16.5% margin, 27% tax), ~0.69 (bull, 18.5%, 26%) and ~0.61 (bear, 11.0%, 30%), so the EV/EBITDA caps translate to ~18.1x / ~27.9x / ~12.4x owner FCF. At the 10.0% WACC of sanity iteration 2 the Gordon multiples are 13.7x (g 2.5%), 14.7x (g 3.0%) and 11.9x (g 1.5%) owner FCF, which are below both the historical EV/EBITDA caps and the retained 15x / 15x / 12x owner-FCF caps, so Gordon growth is the binding term in every scenario and the terminal value sits at ~9.2x / ~10.1x / ~7.3x adjusted EBITDA: base and bull below the 12.13x 10-year average, bear below the 7.62x 10-year minimum. The historical caps are recorded as the ceiling the terminal values sit under; had the first-build 9.0% WACC been retained the 15x/15x/12x FCF caps (~10.1x/10.3x/7.4x EBITDA) would have bound instead.
